The '''Shownar system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located in the [[Parmic sector/Legends|Parmic sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shownar/Legends|Shownar]].
